content: Erythrocyte membrane protein band 4.2 is a protein encoded by the EPB42 gene in humans. This protein is a component of the cytoskeleton and is specifically found in red blood cells. It functions as an ATP-binding protein and is thought to regulate the interaction between band 3 protein and ankyrin. This regulatory role likely contributes to maintaining the shape and mechanical properties of erythrocytes. Mutations in the EPB42 gene are linked to recessive spherocytic elliptocytosis, as well as hereditary hemolytic anemia that is inherited in a recessive manner.
